questions.q: What does a restricted picklist do that a regular picklist does not?
options: It hides the field from reports
It allows multiple values to be selected at once
It rejects any value not on the list, including values submitted through the API
It automatically translates values into other languages
questions.explain: A restricted picklist enforces the value list everywhere, whereas an unrestricted picklist can accept other values through the API.

questions.q: Why do free-text fields cause reporting problems?
options: Every different spelling becomes its own group, so one real category is split and undercounted
Free-text fields cannot be queried with SOQL
Free-text fields are deleted after 90 days
Reports cannot display text values
questions.explain: Without a fixed list, the same real value gets typed many ways, and each spelling is treated as a separate value when grouping.

questions.q: Which query best reveals the different spellings stored in a text field?
options: SELECT Title FROM Contact LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM Contact
SELECT * FROM Contact GROUP BY Title
SELECT Title, COUNT(Id) FROM Contact GROUP BY Title ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
questions.explain: Grouping by the field with a count lists each distinct value and how often it occurs. SOQL has no SELECT *.

questions.q: In the cleanup process from this lesson, what is the step right after you list every variant with GROUP BY?
options: Delete every record that has a variant
Map each variant to a single standard value
Convert the object to a custom object
Export the data and never re-import it
questions.explain: The order is group, map, fix (update by Id), then lock in with a picklist.

questions.q: Why convert a cleaned-up text field to a picklist as the last step?
options: Because picklists are faster to query than any other field type
Because SOQL can only group by picklist fields
So users pick from a fixed list and the same variants cannot creep back in
Because text fields cannot be updated with Data Loader
questions.explain: Cleaning without preventing the cause just repeats the problem. A picklist enforces standard values at entry.
